profile.headline: Remote Embedded Systems Engineer.   Mostly retired.
profile.geoLocationName: New London County, Connecticut, United States
profile.summary:
I do multiple types of engineering and software,  but the bulk of my work has
been in "embedded systems".   Recently I have also been working on Robotic
systems and motion control on small machinery.

On my last "full time" job, I worked on:
Oxygen/CO2 gas concentration.  Dew Point analyzers.
Raspberry Pi based test stations/data loggers.
Python GUI test programs and database migration tools.

Previous job was:
Embedded "Black Box" Telematic device used in Fleet Management System.
Used in marine vessels, heavy duty trucking, stationary assets (e.g. mining conveyor monitoring)
GSM/Satellite connectivity.  Data capture via discrete I/O and various network
busses: CAN, Modbus, J1708, J1939, Smartcraft, NMEA2000

Firmware: C code using Codewarrior IDE for Coldfire Target
Circuit Design: Developed schematic and Microchip PIC18 firmware for J1708 Gateway device.
Desktop: Python GUI for hardware test interfaces, protocol tests, and web data access.

positions.title: Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software (in C)  for gas analysis instrumentation (Gas concentration and dewpoint 
analyzers).   Also wrote software (Python, HTML, PHP)  for Raspberry Pi test stations and data loggers with local and web interfaces.  Also Python database migration tools.

(Alpha Omega was sold to Cosa Xentaur, who later closed down the RI location, so I was laid off.)
positions.insights: Skills: Microprocessors · Embedded C · Embedded Software Programming · Troubleshooting

positions.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
positions.description:
Faria Beede purchased F.W. Telematics (formerly Faria Watchdog)
and it became the Telematics Division.
The product and my responsibilities remained the same.
positions.insights: Skills: Microprocessors · Embedded C · Embedded Software Programming · Troubleshooting

positions.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
positions.description:
Company's main product is a dual-band telematics product (think of it as a real-time black box) which monitors devices (typically vehicles or vessels) condition, reporting via GSM and/or Satellite modem to a central server (or Cloud, to some of you) Fleet Management system.
Most of my work has been with the software and hardware interfaces to the controlled devices:
(Interfaces such as CAN, J1939, RS232, RS485, MODBUS, J1708/J1587)
Some variables monitored: Position, course, speed, fuel levels, engine fault codes, tonnage processed (for mining conveyor systems)..
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Embedded Software Programming · Troubleshooting

positions.title: Senior Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
( Division went through multiple acquisitions - Reverse Chronology)
(August 2008-December 2009 As Conexant) Senior Member Of Technical Staff
Designing Mass Storage  Device control (a USB protocol) for use in Laser or Inkjet printer control ASICs.
(April 2008-July 2008 As Freescale Semiconductor)  Senior Member Of Technical Staff
Converted platform software from propriety RTOS and custom programming to THREADX platform and an SDK format.
(March 2006-April 2008 As Sigmatel) Senior Firmware Engineer
 In addition to working with flash memory drivers, I got heavily involved the the code review process as well as designing firmware test procedures (including regression testing).
(May 2004-June 2006 as Oasis Semiconductor) Senior Firmware Engineer
Troubleshooting some bugs in a soon-to-be-delivered project. Moved into testing of FPGA prototypes of ASIC designs for flash memory and flash card control.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded C · Embedded Software Programming · Troubleshooting

positions.title: System Development Specialist
positions.description: Cofounder,   Primary Systems Architect and Programmer of Distributed control system which controlled high-speed paper handling equipment (mail and insurance policy packaging equipment)
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Troubleshooting · PLC Programming
